metadata.title: Alu Pitika | Mashed Potatoes Assamese Style
metadata.description:
Alu Pitika is unmistakably the signature side dish from Assam. The dish is made with very few ingredients. Mashed potatoes are mixed with few raw mustard oil, finely chopped chilies, onions and coriander that gives it an amazing aroma and a great flavor. 

Sometimes pitikas are even garnished with pumpkins, gourds, boiled eggs or even crushed dry fishes. Making alu pitika is quick as well as a simple process.
